title: R. al-Bāʾiyya ('On the B')

date.basis: MK: 'completed before' the date of the Majlis 10196 copy (item /13, ff. 122b-24a); a copying date and only a terminus ad quem; not asterisked.

addressee: An unnamed postulant (murīd), who asked why the bāʾ is foremost among the letters
occasion: A postulant's question about the precedence of the bāʾ.
manuscript: 2 copies listed: MS Majlis 10196/13 ff. 122b-24a (14 Ramaḍān 828/30 July 1425); Sipahsālār MS 2930/1 (4 Ṣafar 845/1441).
summary: A short lettrist treatise answering a postulant's question why the bāʾ is foremost in precedence among the letters; MK includes an edition in Part 2 (§T.5).
